name: Repo Issue Commands
description: Github Action for automating repo actions via issue/PR commands. Write permission to the repo required.

install-command.description: What command to run to install the repo if the command requires installing it

/ai.enabled.description: Whether to enable the `/ai` command (off by default)

/makerelease.releaseCommitsStartWith.description: When looking back through all the commits until the most recent release, what separator to stop at

/fixlint.enabled.description: Whether to enable the `/fixlint` command (off by default, it runs PR code with the token)

/fixlint.fix-command.description: What command to use to fix the lint

/mergeonpass.enabled.description: Whether to enable the `/mergeonpass` command (off by default)

/review.enabled.description: Whether to enable the `/review` command (off by default)
